title: Purgatory SMP
description: A vanilla-focused Hardcore Revive SMP where every season ends with The Purge, a battle to crown one survivor who earns a permanent legacy in the next season.
body:
# Purgatory SMP
_Season 1 starting soon, join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/Q5PNGwfmyU) to join on open. Also remember joining the discord is required for you to play the SMP_
## Welcome to Purgatory SMP

Purgatory SMP is a crossplay Hardcore Revive SMP built from the ground
up with custom plugins, meaningful PvP, and seasonal events that change
the fate of every player.

Unlike template servers, Purgatory SMP was designed around one goal:
create a survival experience where every decision matters.

Whether you’re a builder, explorer, trader, or PvP veteran, you’ll find
a place here.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Features

-   Java & Bedrock Crossplay
-   Supports all modern Minecraft versions
-   Hardcore Revive system with custom plugin
-   Custom craftable Orbital Wither Skull Cannons
-   Terralith + Tectonic world generation
-   Crystal PvP disabled
-   Simple, vanilla-focused gameplay
-   Proximity Voice Chat
-   Seasonal world resets
-   Balanced PvP and survival

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The Purge

Every season ends with The Purge.

The world border rapidly shrinks until only one player remains.

The winner earns a unique reward in the following season: an infinite
potion effect of their choice (currently without particles), making
every season connected to the last.

No scripted ending. No second chances.

Only one survivor.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Hardcore Revive

Death matters, but it isn’t always permanent.

Our custom Hardcore Revive plugin allows fallen players to be brought
back through gameplay rather than simple respawns, creating real tension
while keeping friends together.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Vanilla First

Purgatory stays close to vanilla Minecraft.

There are no pay-to-win mechanics, overpowered custom items, or
progression skips.

Everyone starts equal and earns their place.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Community

-   24/7 Dedicated Server (London, UK)
-   Active Staff Team
-   75 Player Capacity (expanded whenever needed)
-   Discord Verification
-   Competitive or Casual—play your way

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Rules

-   Griefing, raiding, and stealing are allowed.
-   No cheating or exploiting.
-   Respect staff decisions.
-   Follow Discord rules.
-   Have fun.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Getting Started

1.  Join the Discord.
2.  Verify your account.
3.  Join when the season begins.
4.  Survive.
5.  Make history.

Server IP: purgatorysmp.kinetichosting.io

Discord: https://discord.gg/Q5PNGwfmyU (required)
